description: This file contains unit tests for deployment configuration functions such as 'calculateDeploymentName', 'promoteOnWednesday', and 'promoteByDay'. It uses Node.js testing modules to verify the behavior of these functions with various inputs.

methods.name: promoteOnWednesday
methods.description: Determines if a given date (timestamp) falls on a Wednesday, returning 1 if true, otherwise 0.

methods.name: promoteByDay
methods.description: Calculates the number of days difference between two timestamps.

methods.description: Generates deployment name based on branch name and shard, with specific rules for release branches.
